summary: Cullinan Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 7.01 and 8.01) to furnish a press release presenting updated clinical data from Phase 1 OUTRACE trials for CLN-978 in rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus, and initial Phase 1b/2a data for velinotamig in SLE from Genrix in China. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results with no special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or corporate event. The data show efficacy in two patients and safety in three SLE patients. No risk-arb angle applies as this is solely a pipeline update.
